text: Tigi on, ko noddoton lam e mun kon, gomɗingol ɗoftoo, noddaandu goonga woo alanaa ɗum aduna, wanaa laakara, gooto kadi noototaakau ndun noddaandu. E wonnde pellet, ruttorde men nden, en fow, ko ka Allah tun, e wonnde fantimɓe geddi ɓen, ko ɓen woni yimɓe Yiite ɓen, duumotooɓe ton, Ñalnde Darngal.
